text:
Type: ladder-back wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: solid pine with an antique stain, clear lacquer
Colors: warm medium brown wood, honey brown
Shape: tall ladder back with four horizontal rails, flat solid wooden seat, square straight legs with low side stretchers, sturdy upright frame, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, homely, sturdy, country
Goes with: pine or oak tables, cream or white walls, checked textiles; farmhouse kitchens, rustic or cottage dining rooms

product.name: KAUSTBY
product.description: Solid pine is a natural material which ages beautifully and gains its own unique character over time.
